culture_signals: Together: share context openly and help each other across teams.
Ownership: own problems, fix them and learn from them.
Pace: cut unnecessary complexity to move quickly for clients.
Collaborative environment; teamwork and personal development come first.
Reviewers describe a commercially driven culture with friendly colleagues.

The company pages also describe hybrid work with 3 office days, including for Lisbon, so there is no stated difference. Company-page reviews give culture ratings of 3.4 out of 5 and 3.3 from 15 reviews.
